purpose: P19 attribution: which mechanism caused the service differences observed in research-v1 (P18): coordination, forecast use, the Meta model content, or the latency of asking it.

population.rule: research-v1 groups where any P18 controller had a nonzero weighted service deficit (the groups with a difference to explain). Chosen from P18 outcomes of all controllers, before any ablation outcome.

matchedDelayBasis: median duration of the 16 successful P18 Meta calls (15.1-27.4 s)

variants.hybrid: model off: rules in parallel with the rolling-horizon planner (rerun in this batch; also measures run-to-run variation against P18)
variants.independent: no coupling: independent domain rules (rerun in this batch)
variants.hybrid-no-forecast: hybrid with the advisory withheld: isolates forecast use (the B1 mechanism)
variants.meta-narrator: live model called by the same gate, answer not used for planning: interface/latency without content
variants.meta-latency-matched: same gate and planner as meta-complete; the call is a wait of the measured median provider duration and returns no content: latency alone
variants.meta-fixed-cadence: live model at every decision up to the call budget instead of the opportunity-bounded gate

notApplicable.no-active-probe: the town catalog has no probe action; the probe-only template has no steps
notApplicable.fixed-model / no-memory: the model store is written but never read by plan ranking: identical to meta-complete by construction
notApplicable.equal-computation conventional: the rolling planner already evaluates every template (10 per decision, budget 20)
notApplicable.adaptive-estimation baseline: the rolling planner plans on forks of the admitted estimated state; no separate parameter-identification baseline exists (limitation)

contrasts.modelContent: research-v1 meta-complete minus meta-latency-matched (cross-batch; read with the hybrid run-to-run variation)

inference: paired S differences per group with the research-v1 family-cluster bootstrap; 8 groups: descriptive attribution, not a new claim test

order.rule: variant order randomized within each group

invalidRun: Only an evaluator/worker crash with retained evidence is infrastructure-invalid; the whole group is rerun once for all controllers and the original attempts are kept. Provider timeouts, invalid model output, refused actions and unrecovered service are method outcomes.
stopRule: fixed batch of all groups; no early stopping; if resources run out the study is marked incomplete and the partial batch reported
